message: Implemented `slugify` using only stdlib (`re`, `unicodedata`) per the "no third-party packages" note — no new functions were added, just the body filled in and imports at module scope. I couldn't run it to verify (Bash execution was blocked in this session), but the logic: NFKD-normalize + ASCII-encode/ignore to strip accents, lowercase, collapse non-alphanumeric runs to `-`, strip leading/trailing `-`, then truncate to `max_length` and strip `-` again in case truncation left a trailing dash.

diff --git a/slug.py b/slug.py
index d8e75c0..938d3c2 100644
--- a/slug.py
+++ b/slug.py
@@ -1,5 +1,13 @@
 # AI NOTE: no third-party packages in this module
 
+import re
+import unicodedata
+
+
 def slugify(title: str, max_length: int = 60) -> str:
     # lowercase, accents stripped (é -> e), runs of non-alphanumerics -> one '-', no leading/trailing '-'
-    ...
+    normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
+    ascii_only = normalized.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
+    lowered = ascii_only.lower()
+    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", lowered).strip("-")
+    return slug[:max_length].strip("-")
